CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION homework_private.get_pupil_attempt_status(entered_code text, entered_quiz_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(quiz_id uuid, attempts integer, highest_score integer, passed boolean, unfinished_attempt_id uuid, unfinished_attempt_token uuid, next_question integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_pupil uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT p.id INTO v_pupil
  FROM public.history_pupils p
  WHERE p.pupil_code = pg_catalog.upper(pg_catalog.btrim(entered_code));
  IF v_pupil IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.history_quizzes q
    WHERE q.id = entered_quiz_id AND q.is_published = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pupil or published quiz not found';
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT entered_quiz_id,
    (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM public.history_attempts a
      WHERE a.pupil_id = v_pupil AND a.quiz_id = entered_quiz_id AND a.status = 'completed'),
    (SELECT max(a.score) FROM public.history_attempts a
      WHERE a.pupil_id = v_pupil AND a.quiz_id = entered_quiz_id AND a.status = 'completed'),
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.history_attempts a
      JOIN public.history_quizzes q ON q.id = a.quiz_id
      WHERE a.pupil_id = v_pupil AND a.quiz_id = entered_quiz_id
        AND a.status = 'completed' AND a.score >= q.pass_mark),
    (SELECT a.id FROM public.history_attempts a
      WHERE a.pupil_id = v_pupil AND a.quiz_id = entered_quiz_id AND a.status = 'in_progress'
      ORDER BY a.started_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT a.attempt_token FROM public.history_attempts a
      WHERE a.pupil_id = v_pupil AND a.quiz_id = entered_quiz_id AND a.status = 'in_progress'
      ORDER BY a.started_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT a.question_position FROM public.history_attempts a
      WHERE a.pupil_id = v_pupil AND a.quiz_id = entered_quiz_id AND a.status = 'in_progress'
      ORDER BY a.started_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION homework_private.get_pupil_questions(entered_attempt_id uuid, entered_attempt_token uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(question_number integer, question_text text, answer_options jsonb, time_allowed_seconds integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT homework_private.check_published_attempt(
    entered_attempt_id,
    entered_attempt_token
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Quiz is not available';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    q.question_number,
    q.question_text,
    q.answer_options,
    q.time_allowed_seconds
  FROM public.history_questions q
  JOIN public.history_attempts a
    ON a.quiz_id = q.quiz_id
  WHERE a.id = entered_attempt_id
    AND a.attempt_token = entered_attempt_token
  ORDER BY q.question_number;
END;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION homework_private.pupil_homework_data(entered_code text)
 RETURNS TABLE(valid_code boolean, class_name text, year_group integer, quiz_id uuid, quiz_title text, topic text, week_number integer, due_at timestamp with time zone, total_questions integer, pass_mark integer, attempts_taken integer, highest_score integer, passed boolean, unfinished_attempt_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  WITH pupil AS (
    SELECT p.id AS pupil_id, c.class_name, c.year_group
    FROM public.history_pupils p
    JOIN public.history_classes c ON c.id = p.class_id
    WHERE p.pupil_code = pg_catalog.upper(pg_catalog.btrim(entered_code))
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  current_quiz AS (
    SELECT q.id, q.quiz_title, q.topic, q.week_number, q.due_at,
           q.total_questions, q.pass_mark
    FROM public.history_quizzes q
    JOIN pupil p ON p.year_group = q.year_group
    WHERE q.is_published IS TRUE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM public.quiz_manager_quizzes m WHERE m.runtime_quiz_id=q.id)
    ORDER BY q.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, q.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
  SELECT
    (p.pupil_id IS NOT NULL) AS valid_code,
    p.class_name,
    p.year_group,
    q.id AS quiz_id,
    q.quiz_title,
    q.topic,
    q.week_number,
    q.due_at,
    q.total_questions,
    q.pass_mark,
    COALESCE(s.attempts_taken, 0)::integer AS attempts_taken,
    s.highest_score,
    COALESCE(s.passed, FALSE) AS passed,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.passed, FALSE) THEN NULL::uuid
         ELSE unfinished.id END AS unfinished_attempt_id
  FROM (SELECT 1) seed
  LEFT JOIN pupil p ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN current_quiz q ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'completed')::integer AS attempts_taken,
           MAX(a.score) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'completed')::integer AS highest_score,
           COALESCE(BOOL_OR(a.status = 'completed' AND a.score >= q.pass_mark), FALSE) AS passed
    FROM public.history_attempts a
    WHERE a.pupil_id = p.pupil_id AND a.quiz_id = q.id
  ) s ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT a.id
    FROM public.history_attempts a
    WHERE a.pupil_id = p.pupil_id AND a.quiz_id = q.id
      AND a.status = 'in_progress'
    ORDER BY a.started_at DESC NULLS LAST, a.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) unfinished ON TRUE;
$function$

functions.name: qm3_results
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION homework_private.qm3_results(class_id uuid, quiz_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ DECLARE result jsonb; BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.history_teachers WHERE user_id=auth.uid())
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.history_teacher_classes t WHERE t.user_id=auth.uid() AND t.class_id=qm3_results.class_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='Teacher allocation required'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.quiz_manager_quizzes m WHERE m.runtime_quiz_id=qm3_results.quiz_id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.quiz_manager_quizzes m JOIN public.quiz_manager_allocations a ON a.quiz_id=m.id WHERE m.runtime_quiz_id=qm3_results.quiz_id AND a.class_id=qm3_results.class_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023',MESSAGE='Quiz is not assigned to this class'; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.register_number) INTO result FROM (
 SELECT p.pupil_code,p.register_number,count(a.id) FILTER(WHERE a.status='completed') attempts,max(a.score) FILTER(WHERE a.status='completed') highest_score,
 CASE WHEN max(a.score) FILTER(WHERE a.status='completed')>=h.pass_mark THEN 'Passed' WHEN count(a.id) FILTER(WHERE a.status='completed')>0 THEN 'Not passed' ELSE 'Not completed' END homework_status,
 min(a.completed_at) FILTER(WHERE a.status='completed' AND a.score>=h.pass_mark) first_passed_at,
 CASE WHEN min(a.completed_at) FILTER(WHERE a.status='completed' AND a.score>=h.pass_mark) IS NULL THEN NULL
 WHEN h.due_at IS NULL OR min(a.completed_at) FILTER(WHERE a.status='completed' AND a.score>=h.pass_mark)<=h.due_at THEN 'On time' ELSE 'Late' END deadline_status
 FROM public.history_pupils p JOIN public.history_classes c ON c.id=p.class_id
 JOIN public.history_quizzes h ON h.id=qm3_results.quiz_id AND h.year_group=c.year_group AND h.is_published
 LEFT JOIN public.history_attempts a ON a.pupil_id=p.id AND a.quiz_id=h.id
 WHERE p.class_id=qm3_results.class_id GROUP BY p.id,p.pupil_code,p.register_number,h.pass_mark,h.due_at
 ) x;RETURN coalesce(result,'[]'); END $function$

 SECURITY DEFINER

  IF ROW(OLD.quiz_id,OLD.pupil_id) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.quiz_id,NEW.pupil_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION homework_private.qm_valid_draft(document jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE q jsonb; seen text[] := '{}';
BEGIN
  IF document IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(document) <> 'object'
    OR document->'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb
    OR jsonb_typeof(document->'questions') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    OR octet_length(document::text) > 1048576 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_object_keys(document) k WHERE k NOT IN ('schema_version','questions'))
    OR jsonb_array_length(document->'questions') > 25 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  FOR q IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(document->'questions') LOOP
    IF jsonb_typeof(q) <> 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(q->'id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR length(q->>'id') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR q->>'id' = ANY(seen)
      OR jsonb_typeof(q->'type') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR q->>'type' NOT IN ('multiple_choice','missing_word','matching','chronology',
        'select_all','spot_the_mistake','cause_consequence','who_am_i') THEN RETURN false; END IF;
    seen := array_append(seen,q->>'id');
  END LOOP;
  RETURN true;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION homework_private.save_quiz_result(entered_code text, entered_quiz_id uuid, entered_score integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  found_pupil_id uuid;
  next_attempt integer;
  new_attempt_id uuid;
BEGIN

  -- Only accept a valid score out of 25.
  IF entered_score IS NULL
     OR entered_score < 0
     OR entered_score > 25 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'message', 'Invalid score'
    );
  END IF;

  -- Check the fictional pupil code.
  SELECT id INTO found_pupil_id
  FROM public.history_pupils
  WHERE pupil_code = upper(trim(entered_code));

  IF found_pupil_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'message', 'Invalid pupil code'
    );
  END IF;

  -- Check the quiz exists and belongs to the pupil's year.
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.history_quizzes q
    JOIN public.history_pupils p
      ON p.id = found_pupil_id
    JOIN public.history_classes c
      ON c.id = p.class_id
    WHERE q.id = entered_quiz_id
      AND q.year_group = c.year_group
  ) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'message', 'Quiz not available for this pupil'
    );
  END IF;

  -- Find the next completed attempt number.
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(attempt_number), 0) + 1
  INTO next_attempt
  FROM public.history_attempts
  WHERE pupil_id = found_pupil_id
    AND quiz_id = entered_quiz_id;

  -- Save the completed result.
  INSERT INTO public.history_attempts (
    pupil_id,
    quiz_id,
    attempt_number,
    status,
    score,
    completed_at
  )
  VALUES (
    found_pupil_id,
    entered_quiz_id,
    next_attempt,
    'completed',
    entered_score,
    now()
  )
  RETURNING id INTO new_attempt_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'attempt_id', new_attempt_id,
    'attempt_number', next_attempt,
    'score', entered_score,
    'passed', entered_score >= 20
  );

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_history_class_results(requested_class text, requested_quiz uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(pupil_code text, register_number integer, attempts bigint, highest_score integer, homework_status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_history_teacher() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Teacher access required';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.history_teacher_classes tc
    JOIN public.history_classes c
      ON c.id = tc.class_id
    WHERE tc.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
      AND c.class_name = requested_class
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'You are not allocated to this class';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    p.pupil_code,
    p.register_number,
    COUNT(a.id) FILTER (
      WHERE a.status = 'completed'
    ) AS attempts,
    MAX(a.score) FILTER (
      WHERE a.status = 'completed'
    ) AS highest_score,
    CASE
      WHEN MAX(a.score) FILTER (
        WHERE a.status = 'completed'
      ) >= q.pass_mark THEN 'Passed'
      WHEN COUNT(a.id) FILTER (
        WHERE a.status = 'completed'
      ) > 0 THEN 'Not passed'
      ELSE 'Not completed'
    END AS homework_status
  FROM public.history_pupils p
  JOIN public.history_classes c
    ON c.id = p.class_id
  JOIN public.history_quizzes q
    ON q.id = requested_quiz
    AND q.year_group = c.year_group
    AND q.is_published = true
  LEFT JOIN public.history_attempts a
    ON a.pupil_id = p.id
    AND a.quiz_id = q.id
  WHERE c.class_name = requested_class
  GROUP BY p.id, p.pupil_code, q.pass_mark
  ORDER BY p.register_number,p.pupil_code;
END;
$function$
